headline: Weathered Expanse Rages as Callahans Passage Shifts
war_summary: Since the morning edition the wires show fresh movement in Callahan's Passage, where two Colonial captures at Crumbling Post and the Crumbling Passage to 11:43 have moved holdings to eight Warden and two Colonial, with day losses listed at 8,345 Colonial and 7,359 Warden and short-hour rates accelerating. The Weathered Expanse remains the heaviest desk, adding five changes in two hours and eleven in six for forty-one on the day about Crow's Nest and Frostmarch to 10:35, holdings now two Warden, six Colonial and one destroyed, with 9,754 Colonial and 10,428 Warden day losses. Palantine Berm and Stlican Shelf have gone quiet the past six hours after eleven changes apiece, the former still six Warden to one Colonial and the latter four to five, while Mooring County reports no change in six hours after twenty-five on the day to 03:57 about Wiccwalk and Gravekeeper's Holdfast, still eleven to one. Nevish Line shows no fresh flip since 21:55 last evening.
